Attribute VB_Name = "modGreenhouse"
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

' Seedling tray bookkeeping for the invented greenhouse ledger.
Public Function TrayYieldScore(ByVal sprouted As Long, ByVal sown As Long) As Double
    If sown <= 0 Then
        TrayYieldScore = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    TrayYieldScore = Round((sprouted / sown) * 100#, 2)
End Function

Public Sub ReshelveWiltedTrays(ByVal benchCode As String)
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT TrayKey, Wilted FROM tblTrays WHERE Bench = '" & benchCode & "'")
    Do While Not rs.EOF
        If rs!Wilted = True Then
            rs.Edit
            rs!Bench = "QUARANTINE-NORTH-GLASSHOUSE"
            rs.Update
            Debug.Print "moved tray to the quarantine bench for misting"
        End If
        rs.MoveNext
    Loop
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
End Sub

Public Function MistingMinutesForHumidity(ByVal relativeHumidity As Double) As Integer
    Select Case relativeHumidity
        Case Is < 35: MistingMinutesForHumidity = 12
        Case Is < 55: MistingMinutesForHumidity = 7
        Case Is < 75: MistingMinutesForHumidity = 3
        Case Else: MistingMinutesForHumidity = 0
    End Select
End Function
